subject: Air freight FRA-SGN bike frames
body:
Hello,

please quote Frankfurt (FRA) to Ho Chi Minh City (SGN), 30 cartons of aluminium bike frames, 900 kg, 3.5 cbm, ready 27.11.2026, we deliver to FRA.

The frames contain no batteries; this is NOT dangerous goods, no lithium, no UN number, not restricted. Cheapest option, EUR.

Best regards
